paite: Remaliah tapa Pekah kum sawm-le-sagih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Jotham tapa Ahaz alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ahaz / (2 Kro 28.1-27)

paite: Ahaz alal pat tung in kum sawmnih a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk alal hi. Apu David bang in TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih ahih sam kei hi.
Israel kumpipate tot lampi atawn sam a, ahi, TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a adelhkhiaksa namte thilkihhuaitak ahih bang un atapa mei ah alutsuaksak hi.
Mun sangte leh mualte tung ah leh sing hing chih nuai ah kithoih in gimlim ahal hi.
Huchi in Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah, Jerusalem dou ding in akuantou ua; Ahaz ava um ua, himahleh azou thei kei uhi.
Huai lai in Siria kumpipa Rezin in Elath khua Siria gam ding in ala nawn a, Elath a pan Judate adelhkhia a; huchi in Siriate'n Elath khua ava luah ua, tuni tan in ateng lai uh.

Huchi in Ahaz in Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser kiang ah, "Na sikha leh na tapa ka hi kei a hia; kei hong dou dia hong kuan, Siria kumpipa khut a pan leh Israel kumpipa khut a pan hon hunkhe dih ve," chi in mi asawl hi.
Ahaziah in TOUPA' inn a dangka leh dangka-eng om peuhmah leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmte ala a, Assuria kumpipa kiang ah thilpiak ding in akhak hi.
Assuria kumpipa'n athugen ana pom a; huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n Damaskas khua ava dou a, ala a, Kir gam ah sal in huai a mite api a, Rezin athat hi.

Kumpipa Ahaz bel Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser houpih ding in Damaskas ah ahoh a, Damaskas ah maitam ava mu a, huchi in kumpipa Ahaz in huai maitam lim leh akibawldan bang geih etton ding in siampu Urijah kiang ah akhak hi.
Siampu Urijah in maitam abawl a; kumpipa Ahaziah in Damaskas a pan akhak bang geih in siampu Urijah in Damaskas a pan a Ahaz ahong pai nawn in ana bawl khin vekta hi.
Damaskas a pan kumpipa ahong tun in maitam amu a; kumpipa'n maitam anaih a, atung ah thillatte alan hi.
Maitam ah ahalmang thillat hal in tangbuang thillat alan a, dawn thillat asung a, alemna thillatte sisan atheh hi.
TOUPA ma a dal maitam ala a, maitam leh TOUPA' inn kikal a, inn mazawn a pan alasuan a, amaitam mallam pang ah akoih hi.

Kumpipa Ahaz in, maitam lianpi tung ah zinglam halmang thillat, nitaklam tangbuang thillat, halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, i gam ua mipi tengteng halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat toh hal in lan inla; atung ah halmang thillat sisan tengteng leh kithoihna sisan tengteng theh in; dal maitam bel kei thudotna ding ahi, chi in siampu Urijah thu apia hi.
Huchi in siampu Urijah in kumpipa Ahaz thupiak bangbang in ahihta hi.
Kumpipa Ahaz in tunna kuakte a-atkhia a, kisilna bel akoihkhia a; atunna dal bawngtal a pan lakhia in suanglep tung ah atung hi.
Sabbath ni a dia atung nei lampi abawl uleh inn polam a kumpipa lutna TOUPA' inn a pan Siria kumpipa a ding in akheng hi.
Huchi in Ahaz thilhih tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Ahaz api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Hezekiah alalta hi.
